## A one-day National Level workshop on “Materials Characterisation tools (XRD&SEM) and simulation through DFT” in hybrid mode

29 Aug 2026 - 29 Aug 2026 |Organized by:Physics and Chemistry
The Faculty Development Program aims to discuss the recent advances in the field of characterisation with XRD and SEM. It also covers the simulations using density functional theory (DFT)Venue:MGIT.Event Guidelines:Faculty development program platform: Cisco WebexBefore submitting the Google form for participant registration for the workshop, Please join in Whatsapp Link is provided. The Faculty Development Program aims to discuss the recent advances in the field of characterisation with XRD and SEM. It also covers the simulations using density functional theory (DFT)

## Venue:

- MGIT.

## Event Guidelines:

- Faculty development program platform: Cisco Webex
- Before submitting the Google form for participant registration for the workshop, Please join in Whatsapp Link is provided. All the registered participants for the workshop must join the
- Whatsapp group for receiving workshop meeting links and any other information regarding workshop.
- Attending all the sessions and submission of feedback cum attendance form by participants is mandatory.
- Feedback cum attendance link will be shared in the chat box at the end of the session.
- E-Certificate will be provided to all the registered participants who attend all the sessions and submit day wise feedback cum attendance forms at the end of each session.

## Target Audience:

- Faculty, Research Scholars and PG Students

## Learning Outcomes / Course Outcomes:

- To provide practical exposure to advanced concepts in solid-state and modern physics.

## Resource Persons:

- Will be announced soon

## Coordinator:

- Dr. G. Srinivas Reddy, Mr. S. K. C. Acharyulu

## Co-Coordinator:

- Dr. Archana Jain, Dr. Pardhu Yella
